title: UK ETS aviation verifier-accreditation QA controls

sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme for aviation: how to comply

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Participating in the UK ETS

facts.source_fact: An independent verifier is required unless eligible simplified reporting is chosen.
Any aviation emissions reduction claim must be verified by an independent verifier.
facts.expected_handling: Do not apply simplified-reporting verifier exemption to ERCs.

facts.source_fact: The verifier must be UKAS-accredited for the regulated activity being reported.
Operators must provide the verifier the information needed to perform verification.
Verification assesses information, data and calculations.
Site visits are an important evidence-gathering part of annual verification.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat site visits as parcel measurement.

facts.source_fact: A virtual site visit requires regulator application and supporting evidence by 28 February.
A report amended after verification must be re-submitted to the verifier for re-verification.
facts.expected_handling: Invalidate prior verification after material report amendment.

guard_patterns.handling: Match verifier accreditation to regulated activity.
Require verifier access to needed information.
Keep visit mode and regulator approval distinct.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; 10 x 10 = 100 controls
